episode.title: Are You Just One Version of Yourself?

chapters.title: Introduction: Why Ajay shaved his beard
Chapter 3: Amit recommends primers on classical liberalism

episode.tagline: We could all be many things, but we often allow ourselves to get boxed into one version of us. And we don't even realise this.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay talk about the dangers of allowing yourself to be frozen into one version of you. They also discuss how the process of investigation & prosecution need to be fixed in India. If the incentives are right, it will not be easy for a party in power to harass its opponents using the law. Also, Amit recommends important primers on classical liberlism, and Ajay discusses why Hydroponics are problematic and should be cancelled.
